Commentary.Commentary: So in just about 1 and a half hour from the scheduled start the Match has been CALLED OFF! So not a rosy return of cricket back in Pakistan. The rain was bad and once it stopped it left a lot of water behind that was just too much for the groundstaff and the drainage system to manage. The anticipation and the excitement of the fans has been brutally murdered by the rain and for the first time ever a match has been called off in Karachi due to rain. Misbah-ul-Haq's wait to have his first game as a coach will have to wait. So we now move to the 2nd ODI which will be played at this very same venue on the 30th of September, i.e., Monday. That match will start at 1500 Local (1000 GMT). Hopefully the sun will shine bright on that day and we will have a full game. Join us for that one. Till then, have a great time. Cheers!
